flash_693224.description: A US official says US forces struck Iranian tankers linked to the IRGC after attempted missile attacks on a US Navy ship. Iran warns crews near Kuwait and Bahrain.

flash_693232.description:
Jordan announced that 20 ballistic missiles were launched from Iran toward its territory, with its air defense systems intercepting and destroying 18 of them.

According to the statement, the two remaining missiles landed in areas away from population centers. No casualties were reported in the attack.

flash_693231.description:
Minister of Diaspora Affairs Amichai Chikli attacked the Ra'am party and its candidate Yoav Segalovitz on Tuesday evening.

“We are inches away from the Yamam receiving orders from the Shura Council. This is not a hand on the wheel; it is a hand on the trigger of the State of Israel," Minister Chikli said.

flash_693230.description:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) confirmed that it launched missiles at a US military base in Jordan in response to US attacks on Iranian oil tankers.

At the same time, the IRGC announced plans to attack oil tankers in Kuwait and Bahrain and called on their crews to “abandon the ships."

flash_693229.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio warns Iran that Washington will retaliate for every attempted attack on US assets amid escalating regional tensions.

flash_693228.description: CENTCOM: We destroyed five Iranian crude oil carriers

flash_693227.description: Reports of explosions in Bahrain following launches from Iran

flash_693226.description: Arab media outlets reported that missiles launched from Iran were intercepted over northern Jordan.

flash_693225.description: Technical failure causes major UK air travel disruption, with at least 1,000 flights cancelled and thousands of passengers delayed, including El Al and Wizz Air routes between London and Israel.

flash_693240.description: Former US President shares details about his fight against prostate cancer and the treatments he underwent, stressing the critical importance of screening and early detection.

flash_693239.description: Several Portuguese comedians have withdrawn from a Lisbon festival featuring Jerry Seinfeld, citing controversy over his support for Israel.

flash_693237.description: Thousands protest across Germany after the AfD won nearly 44% in Saxony-Anhalt, as opponents warn of the far-right party's growing political power.

flash_693235.description: Zehut chairman on his alliance with Smotrich: “It’s a technical bloc, and the parties remain completely independent." On polling numbers: “I believe this is just the beginning."

flash_693233.description: The Religious Zionism Party has submitted its Knesset slate, with Ohad Tal pushed down to 12th place. “We acted responsibly to unite the national camp."

flash_693257.description: Hamas terrorists are pulling weapons from storage, stepping up attacks on IDF troops, as terror group moves to reassert military control in Gaza.

flash_693256.description: Netanyahu rejected the claim that the UAE had warned him ahead of the October 7th massacre.

flash_693255.description: Oxford researchers studying more than a million people finds significantly higher risk of esophageal cancer among those drinking too-hot beverages.

flash_693253.description: According to a report by i24NEWS, the Biden administration was not aware before October 7, and is not aware today, of any "concrete warning" conveyed by the United Arab Emirates regarding a major attack being planned by Hamas.

flash_693251.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir salutes wounded soldiers during hospital visit, promises, 'We are with you every step of the way.'

flash_693249.description: Israel is preparing reciprocal measures against countries that joined the recent wave of sanctions against Israelis.

flash_693247.description: Agudat Yisrael and Degel HaTorah draft joint election agreement threatening to withhold coalition support until yeshiva students’ status is secured.

flash_693245.description:
Dozens of missiles were launched towards US bases in Jordan following a US attack on Iranian oil tankers, reports said.

The barrage was clearly visible from Israel, but did not cross into Israeli territory.

flash_693243.description: The Dutch government begins proceedings to revoke Ongehoord Nederland’s license after repeated controversies, including remarks praising Adolf Hitler.

flash_693241.description: A US official told Fox News that 100% of American troops stationed in Jordan are accounted for and that there were no American casualties in the Iranian attacks carried out overnight.

flash_693238.description: Former Beit Shemesh Mayor Aliza Bloch, who has joined the Blue and White slate for the upcoming election, tells Arutz Sheva-Israel National News why she believes the party will outperform expectations.

flash_693236.description: IRGC footage purports to show missile fire on Jordan

flash_693234.description: British PM Andy Burnham defends a new ban on goods from Judea and Samaria, saying Britain must back a two-state solution.

flash_693275.description: US officials assess that Iran plans to use the “Pickaxe Mountain" nuclear site as a shelter for its nuclear program, CNN reports.

flash_693274.description: If Jews do not have the right to live, then ipso facto, Palestinian Arabs have the right to kill them, and it is not murder to do so. Does that bring us closer to peace? Opinion.

flash_693273.description: Ambassador Maya Kadosh tells Arutz Sheva that Hungary’s zero-tolerance policy toward antisemitism allows Israelis and Jews to feel safe in Budapest, while warning of antisemitic rhetoric from the far right.

flash_693271.description: New York State Governor Kathy Hochul announced that $70 million would be spent on providing security for synagogues ahead of the start of the Jewish High Holidays.

flash_693269.description: Iran’s oil shipments are plunging, tanker reserves are rapidly shrinking, and China is seeking alternative suppliers.

flash_693267.description: Security footage captures the dramatic seconds as Gideonim officers move in, draw a weapon and take the suspect away.

flash_693264.description: Palestinian Authority police officers accused of setting up unauthorized roadblock in Area C, detaining and assaulting Israeli civilian in 'serious breach.'

flash_693262.description: Arkansas Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders draws a clear red line on BDS, warning companies that target Israel will pay a price in her state.

flash_693260.description:
United Hatzalah teams arrived at Rabbi Shimon Agassi Street in Jerusalem's Har Nof neighborhood following a gas balloon explosion in a residential building.

Firefighters are operating at the scene, and a three-year-old girl sustained light injuries.

flash_693258.description: Police say new evidence reveals how the supermarket products were allegedly tampered with - but one major question remains unanswered.

flash_693254.description: Gaza report: Israeli UAV struck in western Rafah

flash_693252.description: After losing wife and two daughters to Palestinian terrorists, Rabbi Leo Dee challenges Andy Burnham over proposed boycott: 'I would be happy to debate you on television, anywhere and at any time.'

flash_693250.description: Jacob Coxon, an AI researcher who worked at both Anthropic and OpenAI, has left the industry while issuing a stark warning about the race toward superhuman artificial intelligence.

flash_693248.description: IDF strikes destroy three Hamas, Islamic Jihad, weapons depots packed with rockets and rifles, along with a launch pit used to fire at Israel throughout the war.

flash_693246.description:
The Trump administration reportedly did not oppose the British initiative to impose sanctions on the settlements in Judea and Samaria, and did not even act to block the move, according to Channel 12.

According to the report, the White House's decision not to act against the move, to which 12 Western countries have joined, may indicate frustration in the American administration with the policy of the Netanyahu government.

flash_693292.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband rejects Chief Rabbi Ephraim Mirvis’ warning that sanctions on Judea and Samaria could fuel antisemitism in Britain.

flash_693291.description: Likud demands an investigation into the newspaper and three of its writers over allegations that senior PA official Mohammed Dahlan was involved in the publication of a false report.

flash_693290.description: Iranian reports of explosion in Jask on the Gulf of Oman

flash_693289.description: From Mount Hermon, Defense Minister Katz vows Israel will remain in the Syrian security zone and warns that Iran could face a third Israeli strike.

flash_693288.description:
Biden-era Secretary of State Antony Blinken denied a Haaretz report that Qatar conveyed a Hamas offer to return the hostage immediately after the October 7th massacre and that he rejected it.

"For the record, this is false. Complete fiction," Blinken stated.

flash_693287.description:
Israeli Foreign Minister Giden Sa'ar spoke on Wednesday with Reform UK leader Nigel Farage following the anti-Israel moves by the Labour Government.

Sa'ar thanked Farage for his and his party’s support for Israel. Farage shared that he was pleased to have addressed the Reform Friends of Israel event at the party conference in Birmingham last week.

The British politician also assured Sa'ar that, in government, Reform UK would reverse the damage done to the UK-Israel relationship by the Labour Government and its policies.

flash_693286.description: Dr. Shmuel Katz urges Israelis abroad to participate in the elections and calls on smaller right-wing parties to unite, warning that votes for parties that fail to cross the electoral threshold could ultimately weaken the right.

flash_693285.description: Former NYC Mayor Eric Adams joins Israeli energy company TurboGen’s Advisory Board, helping drive US expansion and new opportunities for its power technology.

flash_693284.description: IRGC says war with the US could end if Washington meets Tehran’s demands on frozen assets, nuclear and missile programs, Yemen and Lebanon.

flash_693283.description: Jewish leaders warn the measures targeting Israeli businesses in Judea and Samaria will isolate Israel, undermine cooperation and hinder peace efforts.

flash_693282.description: The father of captivity survivor Eitan Mor and Religious Zionism Knesset candidate sharply attacks British sanctions on Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria.

flash_693281.description: Tzipi Hotovely, head of Israel’s National Public Diplomacy Directorate, told Channel 12 News that following the boycott targeting Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria, “our intelligence cooperation with Britain will be reduced."

flash_693280.description: Israel Police spokesman Dean Elsdunne speaks to Arutz Sheva about October 7, the battle for Israel’s truth abroad, and why Israelis must keep speaking out.

flash_693279.description: Why all the other signatories of Foreign Secretary Miliband’s antisemitic initiative weren’t also sanctioned by having their consulates in Jerusalem closed is totally beyond me.

flash_693278.description: Answers to the question posed by the Mussar master, Rav Israel Salanter.

flash_693277.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited the Mount Hermon summit with the defense minister. “The main task is to defeat the terror regime in Iran. We are close to achieving that."

flash_693276.description: An allegation from anonymous sources in a book released for maximum marketing sales is ugly stuff. Opinion.

flash_693272.description: The Sages decreed not to blow the shofar out of fear that a single Jew who does not know how to blow might carry his shofar on Shabbat in a public domain. For the sake of that single Jew, we suspend the mitzvah of shofar-blowing that year for all the people of Israel!

flash_693270.description: Nearly two years after fighting for his life, Itamar Galinsky returns to reserve duty in the same unit where he was wounded. 'The nation of Israel lives!'

flash_693268.description: Annual Rosh Hashanah pilgrimage sends rentals and businesses soaring as the Ukrainian city prepares for tens of thousands of visitors.

flash_693266.description: Rebbetzin Esther Jungreis, the sacred lessons of September 11, and a divine call to awaken. Op-ed.

flash_693263.description: On the morning of September 11, 2001, Danny Lewin boarded American Airlines Flight No. 11 in Boston, expecting to reach Los Angeles. In the course of a struggle that took place between Lewin, a graduate of Israel’s elite commando unit, Sayeret Matkal, and the four hijackers who were assaulting the cockpit, Lewin was murdered by armed Satam Al Suqami, a 25-year-old Saudi.

flash_693298.description: Reports of Israeli strikes in several areas of southern Lebanon

flash_693297.description: President Trump predicts the Iran war will end after November’s midterms, accusing Tehran of trying to influence the vote and warning of more US strikes.

flash_693295.description:
President Donald Trump told the press that he believes that the war with Iran will end immediately after the midterm election.

He explained: "They can't hold out any longer. They're desperate to try and affect the election so that we could get a nice, weak group of people in there and leave them alone and let them have their nuclear weapon."

flash_693294.description: IAEA Board refers Iran to the UN Security Council for the first time in 20 years over Tehran’s failure to cooperate with a probe into undeclared uranium.

flash_693293.description: Channel 14 poll shows the right-wing bloc winning 64 seats, compared to 44 for the anti-Netanyahu bloc.

flash_693309.description:
The Democratic Reform Current of Fatah, headed by Mohammed Dahlan, attacked Likud following the party's accusations that Dahlan was behind a report in Haaretz claiming that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ignored a warning received from the United Arab Emirates before October 7.

“We are following the incitement campaign being led by Benjamin Netanyahu and the Likud party against leader Mohammed Dahlan, in a blatant attempt to drag his name into Israel's election campaign and evade the difficult questions Netanyahu is facing inside Israel regarding his political responsibility for the failures of October 7."

It added: “The allegations raised by Likud against Mohammed Dahlan, and the claims that he is interfering in Israel's elections, are nothing more than absurd and misleading allegations. They expose the extent of the confusion and disorder within the Netanyahu camp - a camp that has become isolated on the international stage and tainted by the disgrace of genocide against our Palestinian people."

flash_693308.description: Actor John Malkovich cancels his planned Tel Aviv performance in 2027, claiming an Israeli PR firm falsely attributed quotes to him without his approval.

flash_693306.description: Iranian media report several areas in Sirik have been hit

flash_693304.description: Home Front Command: Incident in northern Israel has concluded

flash_693302.description: Sirens sounded along the northern border due to suspected UAV infiltration

flash_693300.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says Iran will face further consequences for attacks on US ships as Washington maintains economic pressure on Tehran.

flash_693296.description: Israel’s UN Ambassador Danny Danon launches international initiative with dozens of countries, calls for fight against antisemitism to be prioritized in selection of next UN chief.

flash_693313.description:
Iranian Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref responded to the decision by the Board of Governors of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) to refer the issue of Iran's non-compliance with its nuclear nonproliferation obligations to the UN Security Council.

Aref said: “The Iranian nation stands by its legal rights and its strategy regarding nuclear energy for peaceful purposes."

flash_693312.description: Senior Trump advisers have privately warned the Iran war could continue until 2029, despite his public assurances that the conflict will end soon, according to The Wall Street Journal.

flash_693311.description: Israel's acting ambassador to Turkey, Dr. Joel Lion, visited the Turkish Foreign Ministry in Ankara on Wednesday and received the credentials required to begin his duties.

flash_693310.description: Toronto mayoral candidates Brad Bradford and Chris Alexander criticize current Mayor Olivia Chow for skipping a Jewish forum and pledge tougher action on antisemitism.

flash_693307.description: We can stand together without praying together.

flash_693305.description: Following the sirens that sounded a short while ago regarding a hostile aircraft infiltration in several areas in northern Israel, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said that it was determined to be a false identification.

flash_693303.description: The message that Charlie shared cannot be lost with him. Op-w ed.

flash_693301.description: Reports in Iran of explosions in the area of the Strait of Hormuz

flash_693299.description: Apple unveils the foldable iPhone Duo with a 7.6-inch display, alongside the new iPhone 18 Pro lineup.

flash_693325.description: In a recent Iranian attack on a U.S. base in Jordan, about eight F-15 fighter jets sustained minor damage and have already been returned to service.

flash_693324.description: In recent years, Israel's Mossad has helped thwart some 50 attacks in twenty countries, not a few of them in Britain. Perhaps Israel should stop warning ingrates who sanction her to get Muslim votes. Opnion.

flash_693322.description: From the Syrian summit overlooking Damascus, the Israeli prime minister asserts unprecedented control of the northern border and states that the regime in Tehran is “very close" to defeat, recasting the security balance in the Middle East. Is he correct? Opinion.

flash_693320.description: Democratic Sen. John Fetterman praises Republican Dave McCormick and cooperation with Trump in a video appearance during a GOP convention.

flash_693318.description: Marco Rubio says he has no plans to run for president in 2028, while leaving open a future bid as JD Vance emerges as a leading contender.

flash_693316.description: MK Yulia Malinovsky blasts Benny Gantz's decision to run in the upcoming election, asserting: “He is wasting 15 million shekels in public funds on personal whims and ego." Blue and White quickly hits back.

flash_693314.description: Trump says he will speak with Israel, Britain, France and Canada to understand sanctions targeting Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria.

flash_693339.description: Again you shall plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria....

flash_693338.description: A new music video brings voices from 17 countries together to honor October 7 victims and stand with Israel.

flash_693336.description: Yaniv Sardal, 53, located alive after massive overnight search involving IDF, Shin Bet, police and elite forces.

flash_693334.description: Border Police discover advanced tunnel hidden inside ancient water cistern near Givat Ze'ev, arrest suspect carrying digging tools.

flash_693332.description: A new AllJobs survey reveals a striking gap between the holiday gifts employees want and what employers actually give them.

flash_693330.description: IDF, Shin Bet, strikes target facilities packed with explosives, anti-tank missiles and other weapons as Hamas attempts to rebuild military capabilities.

flash_693328.description: Rosh Hashanah does not simply mark the passage of time. It assigns that time meaning.

flash_693326.description: President Trump has announced a proposed 'Trump Dividend' that could put $5,000 in the hands of every adult American if Republicans retain control of Congress.

flash_693323.description: Argentine court orders return of Nazi-looted painting to Jewish collector’s heir.

flash_693321.description: Eight Muslim-majority countries, including Abraham Accords member UAE, welcome UK sanctions on Israeli communities, urging other nations to take similar measures.

flash_693319.description: Trump warns Iran against nuclear activity at Pickaxe Mountain: I would advise them not to get cute.

flash_693317.description: Trump suggests that the Strait of Hormuz should bear his name: I'm sure the Iranian leadership will be thrilled.

flash_693353.description: IAEA chief Rafael Grossi says remote imagery shows movement at Iran’s fortified Pickaxe Mountain site, but inspectors still do not know what is underway.

flash_693352.description: Court orders Tal Yinon Derdik held until end of proceedings after alleged violations of an administrative order issued by Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth.

flash_693351.description: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba terrorist Ismail Kandil, who took part in killing Col. Yonatan Steinberg and recently advanced attacks on Israelis.

flash_693350.description: At Los Angeles stop of Dermer’s Unite. Lead. Fight. tour, Adams and Dermer call for Israel to deploy its intelligence, cyber and strategic capabilities against antisemitism worldwide.

flash_693349.description: Antisemitism is not a misunderstanding to be corrected. It is a functioning social technology that organizes identity, supplies a scapegoat and simplifies the moral universe for people who want it simplified. Rappaport knows how to deal with it. Opinion.

flash_693348.description: Ed Miliband invoked his family’s refuge in Israel before announcing a policy that economically isolates Jewish communities in the land where Jewish history began.

flash_693347.description: David Friedman meets Amishav Melet, the security patrol driver filmed by Mike Huckabee, and pushes back against claims of ‘settler violence.’

flash_693346.description: Stand tall as Jews. Be proud of who you are, even when it is difficult.

flash_693345.description: Ben Gvir’s party claims Likud is working to weaken Otzma Yehudit in order to pave the way for a unity government with Gadi Eisenkot.

flash_693344.description:
Algeria announced that it was severing relations with the United Arab Emirates, saying it had “exhausted all means of preserving bilateral relations between the two countries."

The announcement provided no further details about the move.

flash_693343.description: Capture of Al-Mokha puts Houthi forces closer to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, raising fears of a new chokehold on global trade and energy routes.

flash_693342.description: Shurat HaDin’s Nitsana Darshan-Leitner warns of an escalating campaign to pursue IDF soldiers abroad and explains how a new app aims to protect them.

flash_693341.description: Defense Minister sends New Year wishes to Iran's Jews, warns Tehran any attack on Israel will trigger devastating response.

flash_693340.description: Gaza Division officer battles dismissal while asking the Supreme Court to block publication of his name and his account of the October 7 failures.

flash_693337.description: Britain should be tried at the international level and before an international court for its past and present misdeeds. Opinion.

flash_693335.description: Three M-16 rifles were stolen from soldiers at the Shayetet 13 base in Atlit, with investigators now examining suspicions that an insider was involved.

flash_693333.description: New poll shows two-thirds of US Jewish voters likely to favor Democrats in November midterms.

flash_693331.description: Police release supermarket footage of suspect Yan Shamala, as investigation into anesthetic-laced baby food reaches major breakthrough.

flash_693329.description: Families who lost loved ones gather for Selichot as father of fallen October 7 soldier dedicates Kaddish to all who gave their lives for Israel.

flash_693327.description: Terrorist eliminated in Gaza City strike named as Farah Hamed, senior figure in Hamas' military wing and leader of terror cell; Hamad was among those responsible for murder of Shuli Har-Melekh, husband of MK Limor Son Har-Melekh.

flash_693370.description: President Isaac Herzog marks Rosh Hashanah with a message of Jewish pride, action, and unity, urging Jews in Israel and worldwide to listen to one another.

flash_693369.description: IDF alerts northern residents of explosions that will be heard from Lebanon later

flash_693368.description: Speaking at the Western Wall ahead of Rosh Hashanah, Netanyahu pledges Iran will not obtain nuclear weapons as long as he remains Prime Minister.

flash_693367.description: Farah Hamed, freed to Gaza in the 2011 Shalit deal, was linked to deadly attacks in Binyamin and later recruited Hamas terrorists for attacks in Judea and Samaria.

flash_693366.description: Otzma Yehudit chairman demands compensation from Eisenkot over claims made on a podcast that Ben Gvir spreads violent messages on social media.

flash_693365.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef warns against an Eisenkot-led government, just two months after praising the Yashar chairman and saying Shas could support him for PM.

flash_693364.description: An artistic interpretation of the annual Jewish Holidays.

flash_693363.description:
Earlier today (Thursday), IDF soldiers, in conjunction with the Shin Bet, apprehended the terrorist Ismail Ankaio in the Beitunia area, along with an additional wanted individual.

Ankaio was planning to carry out an imminent shooting attack and was apprehended following a week-long pursuit of him.

flash_693362.description: A child lost consciousness at a shopping center. A medic who arrived within two minutes treated him with two electric shocks, restoring his heartbeat.

flash_693361.description: US Central Command says that as of Thursday, US forces have redirected 96 commercial vessels to ensure total compliance with the blockade of Iran. More than 50 vessels supporting humanitarian aid have been allowed to pass.

flash_693360.description: CyberWell identifies scores of posts falsely blaming Jews and Israel for the 9/11 attacks, warning that decades-old conspiracies continue to spread online.

flash_693359.description: Just before Rosh Hashanah and with elections looming ahead, let us contemplate the great miracles that the Jewish people have undergone.

flash_693358.description: Central Command chief criticizes attempts to create divisions between settlement leaders and forces on the ground, stressing that cooperation is key to maintaining governance.

flash_693357.description: The Japanese government announced that it has lowered its travel warning for Israel. The move is expected to lead to renewed visits by Japanese delegations and businesspeople and to deepen cooperation between the two countries.

flash_693356.description: British government says Israelis at the Western Wall and Jewish Quarter are not unlawfully present, clarifying its stance after adopting the ICJ position.

flash_693355.description: Eisenkot’s Yashar Party will sign a surplus-vote agreement with the Democrats after Liberman’s Yisrael Beytenu struck a deal with Bennett and Lapid.

flash_693354.description: The number of Jewish visitors to the Temple Mount increased significantly this year, despite the site being closed to Jews for 134 days due to security concerns, Muslim holidays and Shabbat.

flash_693379.description: IDF Spokesperson Effie Defrin provides an update from the Ali al-Taher Ridge in Lebanon: All of the terrorists who were inside the infrastructure were eliminated or fled.

flash_693378.description: Hours before Rosh Hashanah, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visits the Western Wall to pray. Watch.

flash_693375.description: Since the end of August, more than 31,000 Hasidim have entered Ukraine in organized groups, with the heaviest influx recorded in recent days.

flash_693374.description: Lebanon reports 4.1 magnitude earthquake as result of tunnel destruction

flash_693373.description: Ehud Olmert backed sanctions imposed by 12 countries on Judea and Samaria and claimed, 'ethnic cleansing is taking place in the territories.'

flash_693372.description: Netanyahu, Katz: IDF has completed the destruction of the terror tunnels in the Ali al-Taher Ridge

flash_693371.description: Finance Minister responds to Gadi Eisenkot’s criticism of the defense budget: “You can’t talk about reconciliation and healing and then speak like the worst of the online commenters."

flash_693383.description: Around 50,000 people attend late night Selichot service at the Western Wall. Rabbis and public figures pray for unity, the safety of Israel's soldiers and the recovery of the wounded.

flash_693382.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said it had received a report of two vessels being attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, approximately 6.5 kilometers west of Khasab, Oman.

According to the agency, the crew of another vessel reported seeing four unidentified missiles strike the two vessels. A fire broke out on one of them, while the condition of the second vessel was unknown. UKMTO reports indicate that several vessels in the area have been affected in recent days amid ongoing military operations.

flash_693380.description: Tens of thousands of worshippers arrive at the Western Wall Plaza in Jerusalem to take part in the final recitation of Selichot before Rosh Hashanah.

flash_693377.description: Britain’s “as-a-Jew" foreign secretary is a disgrace to his people. Opinion.

flash_693393.description: Britain did not recognize Israel until 1950, two years after its founding, and was among the last Western democracies to do so. Part of a pattern. Opinion.

flash_693392.description: Anthropic says it blocked users who tried to use its AI models for potentially harmful biological research, including work involving viruses and toxins.

flash_693390.description: IDF launches surprise drill in the Judea and Samaria Division as part of preparations for the upcoming holidays. All battalions mobilized, and increased security activity will be visible throughout the area.

flash_693388.description: Mohamed Ilyess Akodad sentenced to two years in prison for firebombing a Montreal synagogue after accepting a $15,000 arson offer.

flash_693386.description:
Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in New Delhi, India's capital, ahead of the BRICS summit scheduled to take place this weekend. During his visit, Putin is expected to meet with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and hold additional bilateral meetings.

BRICS comprises Russia, Brazil, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Indonesia and the United Arab Emirates. The summit will be held in New Delhi on September 12 and 13.

flash_693385.description: Trump says he would make the same decision to strike Iran's nuclear sites, warning Tehran will not be allowed to obtain a nuclear weapon.

flash_693381.description: The US imposes new sanctions on Hezbollah and Iranian proxy networks as Washington expands its campaign to cut Tehran off from financial support.

flash_693411.description: Anonymous calls made by a bus driver repeatedly sent police scrambling over fears of terrorist attacks. Following an investigation, police succeeded in identifying and arresting him.

flash_693410.description: The Ministry of Environmental Protection announced that mosquitoes infected with the West Nile Virus were captured in Ashdod. The ministry instructed local authorities to expand prevention, monitoring, information and pest control activities on the subject.

flash_693409.description: Muhammad Yazouri, commander of Hamas’ Khan Younis Brigade, was eliminated in a precise strike along with two other terrorists. IDF: He had worked to advance dozens of attacks against Israeli troops.

flash_693407.description: Behind the scenes of one of the war’s most complex operations: Crossing the Litani River, face-to-face combat, prolonged underground fighting, and destruction.

flash_693405.description: Rachel Rabin Yaakov, sister of the late Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin and one of the founders of Kibbutz Manara, passed away Friday at the age of 102.

flash_693403.description: President Herzog: “Even 25 years later, the evil of that vicious assault on the United States remains as shocking as ever."

flash_693401.description: Axios reports that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman urged Trump to strike the Houthis as they advanced toward the Red Sea chokepoint of Bab al-Mandab. Trump refused.

flash_693399.description: Algeria announces it is severing diplomatic ties with the UAE, accusing the Gulf state of provocative and hostile actions. Abu Dhabi hopes the split is temporary.

flash_693397.description: Senior Fatah official Jibril Rajoub says PA legislative elections may not take place on Nov. 28, calling for national dialogue first.

flash_693395.description: Manhattan DA Alvin Bragg indicts Larry Montes over antisemitic attack that disrupted Shabbat services at Central Synagogue.

flash_693391.description: The Jewish people of tomorrow are growing up in the homes and classrooms of today.

flash_693389.description: CNN reports that more than 100 US military advisers are helping Saudi Arabia with intelligence and targeting as Houthi attacks raise fears of a new regional front.

flash_693387.description: A US official confirms a CBS report that an Iranian missile attack damaged an A-10 and about eight F-15s at a US air base in Jordan.

flash_693384.description:
Yoaz Hendel, chairman of the Reservists Party, approached Ofer Winter, chairman of the Amcha Yisrael Party, with an offer to sign a surplus-vote agreement, but Winter is expected to reject it, Kan 11 News reported Thursday evening.

However, Winter has not ruled out the possibility of signing a surplus-vote agreement with Itamar Ben Gvir's Otzma Yehudit party. Likud plans to pressure Ben Gvir to sign such an agreement later on, despite its negative stance toward Winter.
